title: Vendored media
note: Every asset the landing page needs is served by the app itself, so the clone renders identically offline and does not depend on a third-party CDN staying up. The media belongs to ArtCraft (https://getartcraft.com) and not to this project: it is demonstration content for a local clone, and it is not something the project ships. It is vendored rather than hotlinked so that the page can be diffed against the original; the decision is recorded in ADR-0002, docs/adr/0002-vendor-original-media-and-copy.md.

assets.name: Archivo, the display face (latin subset, variable)
assets.role: The display face. The section headings, the Feature Card and Ownership Card titles, and the Wordmark above the hero headline.
assets.note: One variable file covers both the display face's heading weight (620) and its heavier Wordmark weight (750).

assets.name: Inter, the body face (latin subset, variable)
assets.role: The body face. The paragraphs, the navigation, and the footer.

assets.name: Geist Mono, the monospace face (latin subset, variable)
assets.role: The monospace face. The HUD Label, the call-to-action buttons, and the footer's micro-type.

assets.name: Instrument Serif, the italic serif (latin subset)
assets.role: The Serif Accent: the single italic word inside each headline, such as "for artists", "renting", and "with".
